verdict.rationale: The pack never names official SDKs. The only signs of client-library integration are a hands-on report of easily integrating PostHog into a Swift iOS app, plus a docs line about evaluating flags at runtime from your own tooling. The OpenAPI spec, CLI and MCP server are separate capabilities and are not credited here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of official SDKs, a list of supported languages and platforms, SDK reference docs, and independent corroboration beyond one anecdote.
